header.rule: There is no auction. Everyone announces their HCP (A=4 K=3 Q=2 J=1, always 40 in total) and the pair with more declares, the seat holding more of it becoming declarer. On a 20-20 tie the dealer's side declares; on a seat tie the seat nearest the dealer does. The declarer's partner is the dummy: once the contract is set their hand is face up and the declarer plays both.

roundResult.made: Contract made: {{took}} of the {{need}} tricks needed.
roundResult.down: Contract down: only {{took}} of the {{need}} tricks needed.

tutorial.hcp: There is no auction. Instead **everyone announces their HCP** (A=4 K=3 Q=2 J=1). **They always total 40**, so a 20-20 split is possible — the dealer's side declares when that happens.
tutorial.declarer: Of the pair with more, **the seat holding more of it is the declarer**. Their partner is the **dummy**: once the contract is set that hand goes face up and **the declarer plays both**.
tutorial.contract: A contract needs **6 + level** tricks. Making it scores the contract points (NT is 40 + 30 each after), plus 300 if those reach 100 and 50 if they do not. Going down gives the opponents 50 per trick short.
tutorial.hand: Your hand. Cards you may legally play get a green ring. When it is the dummy's turn, the dummy's cards become the ones you can press.
